events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, as part of the 'Shaved Fish' compilation.

angles.name: Imagine UK Single Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The powerful message of peace and unity still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: The original Apple iPod, famously promising '1,000 songs in your pocket', was unveiled by Steve Jobs on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The first iPod unveiled 25 years ago this month – what was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) – it's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel antics, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: 'The White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A truly diverse and groundbreaking record.

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who passed away at the age of 40.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years after his passing. His legacy of music and peace continues to live on.
